title: Jude and the Escarpment
author: Lior Joubert
blurb: Petra Galloway, an archaeologist's estranged child and better digger, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. Then an old rival hires the crew for the one job that was sworn off long ago — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must beat the salvage fleet to the wreck by six tides, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
